question: What happens when even the supreme Shiva is seen as a reflection in pure consciousness?
premises: Even the supreme principle appears as a reflection in unconstructed consciousness.
One may see this without conceptual thought.
Such seeing leads to becoming Bhairava.
inference: Non-conceptual recognition of even Shiva as a reflection reveals one's own Bhairava nature.
plain_english: Seeing even that supreme principle reflected in the mirror of unconstructed, vast consciousness, and free of conceptual thought, one spontaneously becomes Bhairava.
